calls.statement: SELECT MIN(sale_date) AS min_date, MAX(sale_date) AS max_date FROM fact_sales_line;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) AS month_num,
    TO_CHAR(f.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    o.region,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales_with_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store_old o ON ds.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND ds.store_id < 900  -- Exclude pseudo-locations like online
GROUP BY month_num, month, o.region
ORDER BY month_num, o.region;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) AS month_num,
    STRFTIME(f.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    o.region,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales_with_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store_old o ON ds.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND ds.store_id < 900  -- Exclude pseudo-locations like online
GROUP BY month_num, month, o.region
ORDER BY month_num, o.region;

SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store_old o ON ds.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND ds.store_id < 900  -- Exclude pseudo-locations like online
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY o.region;

FROM dim_store 
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id >= 900

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_with_unmatched_stores
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store_old o ON ds.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
  AND o.region IS NULL;
